questions.text: At what time did a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah go to sojourn in the country of Moab because of a famine?

options.text: In the days when the judges ruled
In the days when King Saul reigned
In the years of the wilderness walk
In the days when King Solomon ruled

questions.text: From which city did Elimelech, his wife Naomi, and their two sons originate?

options.text: From the priestly city Hebron in Judah
From Beth-lehem-judah in the land Judah
From the tabernacle city Shiloh in land
From Bethel in the hill of Mount Ephraim

questions.text: What were the names of the two sons of Elimelech and Naomi who died in the country of Moab?

options.text: Othniel and Kenaz from the south land
Gershom and Eliezer from eastern land
Mahlon and Chilion of Beth-lehem-judah
Phinehas and Hophni from the sanctuary

questions.text: What were the names of the women of Moab whom the sons of Naomi took as wives?

options.text: Miriam and Zipporah of the wilderness
Achsah and Milcah of the noble houses
Deborah and Jael of the mount country
Orpah and Ruth from the country of Moab

questions.text: What counsel did Naomi give unto both her daughters in law on the way to Judah?

options.text: Go, return each to her mother's house!
Follow me unto the tabernacle at Shiloh!
Go immediately unto our kinsmen in Hebron!
Dwell by the fountains in the land of Moab!

questions.text: How did Orpah behave in contrast to Ruth after Naomi's words?

options.text: She refused and went on unto the land of Judah
She kissed Naomi and returned unto her people
She contended bitterly against her mother in law
She demanded straightway the inheritance of her man

questions.text: With what confession did Ruth refuse to turn back from following Naomi?

options.text: I will give thee twenty pieces of silver daily
I will build thee a new habitation in Beth-lehem
Thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God
I will serve the priests at the altar in Shiloh

questions.text: What name did Naomi tell the women of Beth-lehem to call her upon her return?

options.text: Call me Deborah, for the LORD gave unto me strength
Call me Leah, for I have borne great sorrow and grief
Call me Hannah, for the LORD hath heard my sore cry
Call me Mara, for the Almighty hath dealt bitterly

questions.text: At what season of harvest did Naomi and Ruth come to Beth-lehem?

options.text: In the beginning of barley harvest
In the season of grape vintage in fall
At the conclusion of summer fig harvest
In the midst of the late wheat harvest

questions.text: Who was the mighty man of wealth of the family of Elimelech unto whose field Ruth came?

options.text: Elkanah, the godly Levite of Mount Ephraim
Boaz, the wealthy kinsman of Elimelech
Kish, the noble ancestor of King Saul
Jesse, the rich herdmaster of Beth-lehem

questions.text: What commandment did Boaz give unto his young men concerning Ruth's gleaning in the field?

options.text: They should drive her away at once from the fields of the city
They should offer her only bread and water at the dinner time
Let her glean even among sheaves, and reproach and rebuke her not
They should freely give unto her a full tenth of all the harvest

questions.text: Why did Boaz show such great kindness and favour unto Ruth the stranger?

options.text: Because she had brought a great tribute of gold and silver from Moab
Because the elders of the city commanded him to receive all strangers
Because she was a near kinswoman unto his own mother from ancient days
Because it had been fully shewed him all she had done unto Naomi

questions.text: What blessing did Boaz speak over Ruth in Ruth 2:12?

options.text: The LORD recompense thy work under his wings
The LORD give thee rich flocks upon mountains
The LORD make thee a queen over land Canaan
The LORD build thee palaces in tribe Judah

questions.text: What did Boaz invite Ruth to do at mealtime with the reapers?

options.text: To drink royal wine and feast on figs with the reapers
To eat of bread and dip her morsel in the vinegar
To eat a fatted lamb with the elders sitting at the gate
To draw fresh living water from the famous well of David

questions.text: How much barley did Ruth beat out at even after her first day of gleaning?

options.text: About a tenth deal of coarse barley
Two earthen pitchers of fine flour
About an ephah of threshed barley
Five large sheaves of unthreshed wheat

questions.explanation: An ephah was an ancient biblical dry measure for grain, equal to about 20 to 22 liters (Ruth 2:17).

questions.text: How long did Ruth keep fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean?

options.text: Only seven days during the feast of tabernacles
Exactly one month until the feast of passover
Only until the summer fig harvest was gathered
Unto the end of barley harvest and wheat harvest

questions.text: What instruction did Naomi give unto Ruth concerning Boaz at the threshingfloor?

options.text: To uncover his feet and lay herself down softly
To bring a bag of silver and present it secretly
To cry aloud for marriage before all the reapers
To measure the corn in the storehouses at night

questions.text: What did Ruth ask of Boaz on the threshingfloor in Ruth 3:9?

options.text: To give her ten measures of fine wheaten flour
Spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid
To set her as an overseer over all his reapers
To deliver Naomi from all bondmen of the city

questions.text: What testimony did Boaz give concerning Ruth in Ruth 3:11?

options.text: That she was the richest woman among the strangers
That her wisdom exceeded the words of the elders
All the city doth know thou art a virtuous woman
That she was sole heir of all house of Elimelech

questions.text: What legal obstacle did Boaz mention before he could redeem the inheritance?

options.text: The field of Elimelech had already been pledged to another
The elders of Beth-lehem had forbidden the purchase of land
Naomi had not yet performed her solemn vow before the priests
Howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I to redeem the field

questions.text: With what measure of barley did Boaz send Ruth home in the morning?

options.text: He measured six measures of barley
Two full sacks of fine wheaten meal
A half measure of clean beaten grain
Ten earthen jars of the best olive oil

questions.text: Where did Boaz go up and sit down to resolve the matter of the inheritance?

options.text: In the outer court of tabernacle at Shiloh
In the gate of the city of Beth-lehem-judah
Upon the threshingfloor outside the gates
In the house of Eli the high priest of God

questions.text: How many men of the elders of the city did Boaz take to sit as witnesses?

options.text: Seven men of the elders
Twelve men of the elders
Ten men of the elders
Seventy men of the elders

questions.text: Why did the nearer kinsman refuse to redeem the parcel of land for himself?

options.text: Because he had not sufficient silver in his house
Because the elders refused to confirm his right
Because Naomi set the price of the land too high
Lest I mar mine own inheritance by redeeming it

questions.text: What manner of testimony was used in Israel to confirm redeeming and changing?

options.text: A man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour
They broke an earthen jar in pieces before the ten elders
They poured a full measure of barley upon the city thresh
They kindled a holy torch of fire at the city gateposts

questions.explanation: Plucking off the shoe was an ancient custom in Israel to openly attest the relinquishment of property and right of redemption (Ruth 4:7-8).

questions.text: What blessing did all the people in the gate and the elders speak over Boaz?

options.text: God multiply your flocks as the sands by the great sea
The LORD make the woman like Rachel and Leah to build Israel
May she reign as a mighty princess over the land of Canaan
May thy house be honored equal to the priestly tents of God

questions.text: What did the women her neighbours name the child born unto Ruth and Boaz?

options.text: Jesse, who was the father of David
David, who was the anointed king
Obed, who is the father of Jesse
Pharez, who was the ancient father

questions.text: Which king descended from Obed and Jesse according to the close of Ruth?

options.text: King Solomon, prince of peace
King Saul, the son of Kish
King Hezekiah, faithful ruler
King David, the son of Jesse

questions.text: With whose generations does the genealogy at the end of the book of Ruth begin?

options.text: With the generations of Pharez
With the generations of Nahshon
With the generations of Salmon
With the generations of Hezron

questions.text: Who said unto Naomi: "Whither thou goest, I will go; thy people shall be my people"?

options.text: Hannah
Ruth
Rahab
Orpah

questions.text: What were the names of the Moabitish wives of Naomi's sons (Ruth 1:4)?

options.text: Michal
Hannah
Ruth
Orpah
